messages:
anna (pm): Quick heads-up: PM/Docs/Eng aligned on a formal sunset playbook for the legacy sync SDK bindings. This thread is the canonical internal announcement + action tracker. Please react with :eyes: if you need to be looped into the weekly sync.

liam (eng): high-level ask: can we keep runtime compatibility for 9-12 months but start nudging with docs + warnings? we need runway for infra changes.

anna (pm): Exactly. Proposed schedule: (1) 60-day soft notice + migration resources, (2) 120-day beta of codemods and shim, (3) 9 months: CI enforcement opt-in, (4) 12 months: sunset and move legacy pages to /docs/legacy. Feedback welcome.

sofia (docs): I'll prepare a short "migration checklist" page (one-pager) and per-language quickstarts. Plan: checklist + migration snippets + rollbacks. Target: publish initial drafts in 7 business days.

rahul (sre): We need a compatibility matrix that shows which model runtimes and quantizations are supported under the shim. Also will run usage scans to find orgs still on sync bindings.

jess (security): For private deployments we should add a compliance note — some customers will require an on-prem shim or longer timeline. Legal wants a short FAQ entry.

liam (eng): dev plan for shim: make a tiny proxy package that imports async runtime and exposes the old sync interface via threads/executor. Will ship as `redwood-legacy-shim`. We'll include a feature flag env var REDWOOD_LEGACY_SHIM=enabled to allow orgs to opt-in.

sofia (docs): Draft banner copy suggestion: "Heads up — this SDK surface is scheduled for sunset in 12 months. Follow the migration guide to upgrade to the async SDKs."
Include example code blocks and a before/after diff in the guide.

ci-bot: New pipeline: legacy-sdk-usage-scan started for orgs: redwood-team, partner-org, alpha-testers.

liam (eng): Codemod plan: JS/TS will use jscodeshift rules; Py will use libcst transforms for common call patterns. We'll publish example transforms and a rollback step.

sofia (docs): Action items for docs:
- Publish migration checklist (7 days)
- Add top-of-page banners where old sync API is referenced (3 days)
- Create step-by-step codemod walkthrough with sample PRs (14 days)
Assigning to @sofia and @mike for review.

anna (pm): Telemetry plan: aggregate counts only (calls, error rates, org-id), opt-outable per-org, no request payloads logged. We'll expose a console widget showing migration progress for repo owners.

rahul (sre): We'll add a dashboard and weekly digest to owners. Also want an escalation path if a high-value customer is impacted.

jess (security): Confirming: no payloads, opt-out available, storage retention 30 days for migration metrics only. Legal will review draft text.

liam (eng): One more: we'll add a small compatibility shim matrix to the RFC listing supported GPUs, kernels, and quantization combos. This helps infra plan for Dedicated & Private.

sofia (docs): I'll link the RFC and the shim repo in the migration checklist once they exist. Keep the checklist short (3-5 steps) so eng teams can follow fast. Example step: 1) run usage scanner 2) install shim and run tests 3) run codemod and open PR 4) opt-in CI lint enforcement.

anna (pm): Publish links: RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/legacy-sync-sunset (internal), initial checklist: /docs/migration/legacy-sync-checklist (draft).

docs-bot: Created pages: /docs/migration/legacy-sync-checklist, /docs/announcements/legacy-sdk-sunset-playbook.

liam (eng): Release cadence: beta shim + codemod in ~120 days to the beta channel. Will tag repos for early adopters.

sofia (docs): I'll prepare a short email + slack blurb to go to all-eng when checklist is live. Template PRs for samples repo incoming.

anna (pm): Weekly sync starts next Wednesday 11am PT. If you're owning any action item add it to the RFC tracker. Thanks all. :tada:
